items.q: Can I put a purchase on an invoice?

a.v: Yes, if you are offered the option of paying by invoice you may take it.
Check with your result owner before taking something on invoice if you can. The invoice is attested like any other purchase, and without attest you may have to pay it yourself.

items.q: Who should the invoice be addressed to?

a.v: The guild. Make sure the supplier invoices D-sektionen and not you as a private person.
The guild will NEVER pay invoices that are not addressed to the guild. If you have been invoiced privately, you have to pay the invoice yourself and then file it as an expense claim.
